stage.001.tip1: Welcome to Water Closet! Your goal in each stage is to escape down the toilet.
stage.001.tip2: Walter (that's you) will encounter all manner of weird and wonderful stuff on his journey home, so be prepared.
stage.001.tip3: These tips will show up from time to time during the game to aid you on your journey. Press [F1] to show them again if you get stuck. A little blue information icon will appear in the top status bar when they are available.
stage.001.tip4: For now, head right to dive down the toilet and complete this first screen.
stage.002.tip1: Skill is required at all times. Here, you will need to jump over the gaps in order to reach your escape route. If you mess up, you'll need to go back around to the beginning.
stage.002.tip2: Falls aren't deadly in this weird world, so Walter can fall from great heights and not take any damage.
stage.003.tip1: Some stages aren't just a single screen (gosh, what an innovation!). Also, in this case, you'll need to proceed to the left, rather than right (another great gameplay element!).
stage.003.tip2: However, if you mess up these jumps you'll have to start the stage over. Press [Backspace] to restart a stage from the beginning.
stage.004.tip1: You've probably noticed that there's a clock in the top right-hand corner. Yes, your thinking is correct: that's a time limit!
stage.004.tip2: Most stages will have a time limit in order to keep things interesting and keep you on your toes. If you fail to make it to the toilet, it will overflow and Walter will be trapped.
stage.004.tip3: Hurry to the toilet before time runs out and flush yourself down!
stage.006.tip1: Coins! Another unique gameplay element! Walter loves his coins and they can be found scattered around some levels. You can see how many coins you have collected and how many remain at the top of the screen.
stage.006.tip2: Collecting coins isn't required, but it will fill you with a certain sense of accomplishment for having done so. Naturally, some are going to be more difficult to collect than others. Hop to it!
stage.009.tip1: Oh no, the door to the toilet is blocked by a door (bet you didn't see that coming). Luckily, there's a key over to the left that can be used to unlock it.
stage.009.tip2: Grab the key and then walk into the door to open it. In this world, keys break when they are used because the locksmiths made them exceptionally brittle for some stupid reason.
stage.012.tip1: And now for something more interesting - the key to open the toilet door is down there, but Walter won't be able to get back up once he grabs it. What he needs is a buddy to assist him
stage.012.tip2: Luckily, Walter can create limited clones of himself that will repeat his past actions (while Walter himself is reset to the starting point). The clone can be used to grab the key!
stage.012.tip3: Try it now: grab the key and then press [Space] to create a clone that will repeat all of Walter's previous actions. If you mess up, press [Backspace] to restart the level over.
stage.012.tip4: Maybe also grab that item on the left while you're at it, for added bragging points.
stage.013.tip1: Oh no, spikes! Just like in real life, they will kill you if you fall on them. Walter would rather that doesn't happen, but he's got no choice in the matter. Thankfully, he can just clone himself to overcome that issue.
stage.013.tip2: One very important thing to keep in mind: the clock doesn't reset when using clones, so Walter will need to be quick about things.
stage.016.tip1: A traffic light! How on earth did that thing get here?! Well, at least it's good to know there's electricity in this place.
stage.016.tip2: The traffic light can be used to control things, such as doors. In the absense of a key, it's the next best thing. Walk over to the traffic light and press [J] to interact with it, opening the door.
stage.018.tip1: Walter's clones can use the traffic lights, too! Team work will be required to overcome this stage and get to the exit.
stage.021.tip1: Oh no! That pipe is ejaculating green slime! It's deadly to the touch, so Walter must avoid it at all times.
stage.021.tip2: It should be easy to jump over, however, and the slime bolts can't pass through walls.
stage.024.tip1: Traffic lights can also control slime bolt spitters, just like in real life.
stage.026.tip1: Using clones to take the blows for you just isn't cricket, is it? But what's this? A manhole cover! Hurrah! It can be used as a shield. It looks pretty heavy, so you probably won't be able to jump while holding it.
stage.026.tip2: Walk into the hanhole cover and Walter will hold it in front of him. Slime bolts won't hurt Walter while he's holding it. So long as they don't hit him in the back, that is. Try it now!
stage.029.tip1: Wow, a moving platform! Another novel and unexpected entity. Walter can hardly believe his eyes. It's so pristine compared to everything else and appears to move by magic.
stage.029.tip2: As expected, moving platforms can carry things around, allowing you to reach places that might otherwise be out of reach. So, hop on and go for a ride.
stage.029.tip3: (Yes, you can probably expect for pushable square boxes to show up at some point, too. Try to act surprised when they do.)
stage.033.tip1: Uh oh! That toilet doesn't looks very clean. Well, okay, none of them up to this point have been, but this one looks especially gross. You can see the stink lines coming off it from miles away.
stage.033.tip2: Ordinarily, Walter would want to go and find one in better condition, but this is his only way out. But lo! There's a plunger. Grab it and use it to dislodge the foul blockage.
stage.033.tip3: Be warned: don't go near it while it's in need of plunging or it could destroy you!
stage.040.tip1: Ah ha, a pressure plate! It will activate when weight is applied to it (such as Walter, his clones, and other things). You can probably figure out the rest from here!
stage.045.tip1: A pushable crate. A pressure plate linked to a locked door. No clones. Don't act surprised. You know what to do.
stage.051.tip1: Slime drips! They're as deadly as the ones that issue from the pipes. Best dodge them.
stage.055.tip1: Consider what the clone WILL be doing and not what it IS doing.
stage.058.tip1: A water pistol, just like the one Walter had when he had that one summer when he took part in the wet t-sh... ummm, anyway ...
stage.058.tip2: It can be used to inflate blue balloons, which will in turn do things like open doors, activate platforms, and all that. Just like water balloons in real life.
stage.058.tip3: Grab the pistol and inflate that balloon to escape!
stage.059.tip1: Some water balloons aren't as good as retaining water as others, so will leak. Walter had best be quick!
stage.064.tip1: This is it: Walter's final challenge! You're going to need to draw upon all your skills and everything you've learned to make it through. Timing is key!
story.text: While chowing down on a half-frozen, out-of-date lasagne that he bought from the discount shop down the road after 10 pints at the Crown and Lion, Walter Chambers has found himself in a strange world that resembles a sewer system! Either the food he ate has somehow transported him to an alternative dimension or he's hallucinating. Whatever's happened, he knows only that he needs to escape this bizarro place. And there's just one way out: down the toilet (like that bit out of Trainspotting)! Luckily, Walter has a number of tricks up his sleeve, all of which he'll have to make use of if he wants to get back home in time to feed his cat and find out how Game of Thrones ends.
